documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says «占领卡兹戴尔» (occupy Kazdel).
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the more literal CN wording with «захватить Каздель».

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says Julie has hardly met any Felines.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN adds «who can do that», which is not present in CN.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add the English qualification.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says Ascalon does not want Julie and Her Highness to meet; it gives no explicit time qualifier.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and omits the added time qualifier.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says Julie appreciates Ascalon coming to see her off.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN reframes the line as not minding that Ascalon gives her the clothes.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN compares Julie's unfamiliarity to not recognizing a shadow and another self.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN replaces the image with an unfamiliar reflection in a mirror.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian keeps the CN image of a shadow and another self.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says the group is preparing to operate in Kazdel.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN says the squad is heading off to Kazdel.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN's wording about operating in Kazdel.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says the wounded assassin might not beat even a sturdy ordinary person.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN narrows this to a civilian.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the broader CN wording.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN literally says Julie killed them all.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN uses the idiom 'As a doornail'.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN uses 同胞, meaning compatriot or fellow member of the same people.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian uses «сородич», following the CN kinship meaning.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN explicitly characterizes the assassin's laughter as the laughter of release or relief.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN says only that the assassin laughs.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian preserves the relief nuance present in CN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says his portrait circulated in an illustrated album of anecdotes.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN calls it the Scar Market's book of bounties.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the CN image of an illustrated collection of stories.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN asks whether the masked death-soldiers, like the wounded assassin, enjoy self-mutilation (自残); it does not specifically mention cutting off horns.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN narrows the question to whether they like chopping their horns off.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the broader CN wording: «калечить себя».

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN uses «魔王» (Demon King) alongside «六英雄» (Six Heroes).
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN renders the title as «King of Sarkaz».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian uses the established project glossary form «Король Сарказов» for this title; the term mapping is documented.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says Julie and her companions pile the assassins' corpses together and set them all alight.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN adds the image of a «grisly pyramid».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN and does not add a pyramid.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says only some Royal Court members of the Military Commission remain stationed in Kazdel; Theresis has almost abandoned the city.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN expands this to Royal Court factions aligned with the Military Commission overseeing the city.
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows the narrower CN statement.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN says Theresa will remain aboard the ship and that a suitable force will guard it under the Doctor's command.
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN adds that Theresa remains aboard «to balance the situation».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian omits the added rationale and follows CN.

documented_meaning_differences.cn: CN names the «议事厅» (council chamber) and uses singular «月亮» (moon).
documented_meaning_differences.en: EN calls it the Royal Court's chamber and uses plural «moons».
documented_meaning_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN: «зал совета» and singular «луна».
